caseName: International Longshoremen's Ass'n v. Consolidated Express, Inc.
caseNameFull: International Longshoremen's Assn., AFL-CIO v. Consolidated Express, Inc. New York Shipping Assn., Inc. v. Consolidated Express, Inc. and Consolidated Express, Inc. v. New York Shipping Assn., Inc.

opinions.text: C. A. 3d Cir. Certiorari granted, judgment vacated, and cases remanded for further consideration in light of NLRB v. Longshoremen, 447 U. S. 490 (1980). Reported below: 602 F. 2d 494.
